title: Add five reviewed mineral and electroplating-effluent records
counts_status: Provisional expected final census; reconcile with actual checks before publication.
selection: Five additions distinguish four mineral species and a liquid secondary resource. Two retain primary natural-specimen characterization; the others cover bacterial metacinnabar dissolution, a qualified yeast-associated meta-ankoleite assignment and cyanobacterial biomass sorption from real electroplating baths.
limitations: Phase identity, inferred pathways, source contradictions and laboratory scope remain explicit. Criticality is not inherited from constituent elements; source follow-ups remain open.
